# ankra_security_compliance_frameworks (Data Source)

Lists the compliance framework catalogue and which frameworks the organisation tracks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_security_compliance_frameworks" "all" {}

output "available_frameworks" {
  value = [for framework in data.ankra_security_compliance_frameworks.all.frameworks : framework.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `frameworks` (Attributes List) Frameworks in the catalogue. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--frameworks))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--frameworks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `frameworks`

Read-Only:

- `automated_control_count` (Number) Controls the platform evaluates automatically.
- `control_count` (Number) Controls the framework defines.
- `description` (String) Framework description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the organisation tracks the framework.
- `enabled_at` (String) When the framework was enabled.
- `key` (String) Framework key, as `ankra_security_compliance_framework` takes it.
- `short_title` (String) Short framework title.
- `title` (String) Framework title.
- `version` (String) Framework version.
